svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'
svg.title: DeepMzyme architecture
svg.desc: A holo protein structure and a supplied metal position (the metal's element is never used) feed three branches. Structure: a graph of the protein residues with any atom within 10 Å of the metal, linked when their closest atoms are within 8 Å, encoded by a four-layer GVP-GNN and pooled over the pocket residues. Sequence: each chain embedded in full by frozen ESM-C 600M and pooled over the same pocket residues. Site: a four-value summary that is constant in this release. A sigmoid gate computed from the two pooled vectors scales the sequence vector; the three vectors are concatenated (288 values) and an MLP gives softmax scores for five classes: Mn, Cu, Zn, Fe and Co/Ni. The release sums Fe and Co/Ni into Class VIII and averages the 4-class scores of five copies, each trained with one CV fold held out.
svg.text: any atom ≤ 10 Å from the metal
frozen; all other modules are trained together
σ gate: a 0–1 weight for each of the 128 h_seq values, computed from h_struct and h_seq · ⊙: element-wise product · attention: weighted average, a learned score per residue
First shell: side-chain donor atom ≤ 2.7 Å from the metal · second shell: side-chain group ≤ 4.5 Å from a first-shell group · not used: waters, small molecules, other metals
Shown: one network of public release unified_p5_trunklr1e4_5fold_s42, which averages the 4-class scores of five such networks, each trained with a different CV fold held out.
Drawings are schematic; a real pocket has about 38 residues (training median).
